Worktree has no node_modules. package.json depends on file:../packages/auth-sdk, which from the worktree resolves to hrms-frontend-worktrees/packages (missing). test_framework: vitest (node env, globals; 5 existing tests: components/FormBuilder/validation.test.ts, EmptyState/EmptyState.test.ts, WorkflowEngine/WorkflowEngine.test.ts, DataTable/useFilterSync.test.ts, pages/onboarding/OnboardingTracking.test.ts; no npm script, run `npx vitest run`). @playwright/test is a devDependency but there is NO playwright.config and 0 specs.
test_command: npx vitest run && npx playwright test
verification_instructions: After every FEAT run: npm run build; npm run lint (record baseline findings first); npx vitest run; npx playwright test. For migrated routes also capture SHOT_NAME=after screenshots and compare with the baseline set captured in FEAT-001.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Screenshot PNGs go OUTSIDE the worktree to /Users/admin/Documents/GitHub/Leadspoint CRM/hrms-frontend/.agents/tasks/hrms-minimal-restyle/screens/{baseline,after}/<route-slug>.png (env SHOT_DIR, SHOT_NAME) so they are never committed.
environment_constraints: Never push or deploy. Use absolute worktree path /Users/admin/Documents/GitHub/Leadspoint CRM/hrms-frontend-worktrees/minimal-restyle; relative paths land in the parent workspace. Playwright cannot log in through identity-center: seed localStorage keys platform_auth_access_token, platform_auth_refresh_token, platform_auth_token_expiry (see packages/auth-sdk/src/tokenStorage.ts) with an unsigned JWT whose payload exp is in the future (AuthProvider only decodes it), and mock every API call with page.route. Set VITE_API_BASE_URL, VITE_IDENTITY_CENTER_URL, VITE_AUTH_CLIENT_ID, VITE_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI for the Playwright webServer.
contribution_requirements: No functional change: routes (src/router/index.tsx), API calls (src/lib/api.ts, endpoints.ts), permissions (HrmsPermissionsContext, Can, RoleGatedRoute, FeatureGatedRoute) and component props stay identical. No MUI, no Radix, no new component library. No demo pages, mock data or unused components. Migrated files use semantic tokens only: no raw hex, no bg-blue-*, no primary-NNN.
key_patterns: Shared components in src/components/<Name>/<Name>.tsx with index.ts barrels: DataTable (67 pages), CrudModal (60; FieldConfig type text|textarea|select|date|number|checkbox|time), ActionButton (64), ConfirmDialog, MetricCard, EmptyState, Skeleton, FormBuilder, ChartWidget, Layout/{AppShell,Sidebar,Header,NavIcon with inline SVGs}. AppShell: flex h-screen, Sidebar(isOpen,isCollapsed,onClose,onToggleCollapse), Header(onMenuToggle), main p-4 sm:p-6, Suspense around Outlet. Pages are lazy-loaded in the router. 54 files hand-roll fixed inset-0 modals (mostly src/pages/settings/*Tab.tsx, leave pages, RecruitmentStages, DocumentRequests, Gratuity, CompensatoryLeave); 37 pages use raw <table>. src/index.css sets body bg-gray-50 with a system font stack. tailwind.config.ts only has a blue primary 50-950 scale and no darkMode.
